description: This file is a Smarty plugin that provides a modifier function named 'debug_print_var' used for formatting variables for debugging purposes within the Smarty templating engine. It recursively outputs the contents of arrays and objects with visual indentation and styling, converting special characters to HTML and truncating long strings.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_debug_print_var
methods.description: Formats a variable for display in debugging, handling different types like array, object, boolean, string, integer, float, and null, with recursive processing for arrays and objects.
